# Notes on living

These are not finished ideas. They are observations gathered while trying to understand what makes a life feel vivid, honest, and fully lived.

Some have held up. Some will not. I keep both.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.documentElement.classList.add("journal-enhanced");
const entries = document.querySelectorAll(".journal-entry");
if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((items) => {
    items.forEach((item) => {
      if (item.isIntersecting) {
        item.target.classList.add("is-visible");
        observer.unobserve(item.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.14, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8%" });
  entries.forEach((entry) => observer.observe(entry));
} else {
  entries.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.add("is-visible"));
}
</script>
```
